h2: Discovery 3/4 TDV6 / SDV6 Timing Chain Issues?||
description: Timing-chain tensioner wear, injector-seal leaks and crankshaft bearing failure risk are widely documented on the TDV6/SDV6, backed by multiple TSBs and specialist sources. Injector harness oil contamination and crank sensor failure are an established pattern on the Discovery 2's Td5. The modern Discovery's Ingenium diesel shares the same timing-chain and injector-seal pattern found across the rest of the current Land Rover range.

callout.title: A Well-Documented Issue
callout.body: 200Tdi / 300Tdi injector seal leaks and timing chain wear are widely documented across Land Rover specialist forums and official TSBs.

heroHook.title: Include In Hero Hook:
heroHook.body: Yes — both verified: 200Tdi / 300Tdi widely documented with multiple TSBs; the wear pattern is well established and something our Land Rover specialists repair regularly.

features.title: New Timing Chains
features.body: Replaced as standard (where worn or damaged)

features.title: Peace Of Mind
features.body: No hidden extras — just a stronger, longer-lasting engine
